name: private_homework_attachment_storage
query: insert into storage.buckets (id, name, public, file_size_limit, allowed_mime_types) values ('homework-submissions','homework-submissions',false,5242880,array['application/pdf','image/jpeg','image/png','application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document']::text[]) on conflict (id) do update set public = false, file_size_limit = excluded.file_size_limit, allowed_mime_types = excluded.allowed_mime_types; create policy homework_submission_file_owner_insert on storage.objects for insert to authenticated with check (bucket_id = 'homework-submissions' and (storage.foldername(name))[1] = (select auth.uid()::text)); create policy homework_submission_file_scoped_read on storage.objects for select to authenticated using (bucket_id = 'homework-submissions' and ((storage.foldername(name))[1] = (select auth.uid()::text) or private.is_admin() or exists (select 1 from public.uploaded_files uf join public.homework_submissions hs on hs.attachment_file_id = uf.id join public.homework h on h.id = hs.homework_id where uf.storage_key = storage.objects.name and h.teacher_id = private.current_teacher_id()))); create policy files_homework_marker_read on public.uploaded_files for select to authenticated using (exists (select 1 from public.homework_submissions hs join public.homework h on h.id = hs.homework_id where hs.attachment_file_id = uploaded_files.id and h.teacher_id = private.current_teacher_id())); drop function public.submit_homework_submission(uuid, text); create function public.submit_homework_submission(p_homework_id uuid,p_content text,p_attachment_file_id uuid default null) returns uuid language plpgsql security invoker set search_path = public, auth as $$ declare v_student_id uuid; v_submission_id uuid; begin v_student_id := private.current_student_id(); if v_student_id is null then raise exception 'Only a linked student account can submit homework.' using errcode = '42501'; end if; if coalesce(length(trim(p_content)), 0) = 0 then raise exception 'Submission content is required.' using errcode = '22023'; end if; if p_attachment_file_id is not null and not exists (select 1 from public.uploaded_files where id = p_attachment_file_id and owner_id = (select auth.uid()) and purpose = 'homework_submission' and byte_size <= 5242880) then raise exception 'The attachment is not available to the current student.' using errcode = '42501'; end if; if not exists (select 1 from public.homework h join public.enrollments e on e.class_id = h.class_id where h.id = p_homework_id and h.status = 'PUBLISHED' and e.student_id = v_student_id and e.status = 'ACTIVE') then raise exception 'This homework is not available to the current student.' using errcode = '42501'; end if; insert into public.homework_submissions (homework_id, student_id, content, attachment_file_id) values (p_homework_id, v_student_id, trim(p_content), p_attachment_file_id) on conflict (homework_id, student_id) do update set content = excluded.content, attachment_file_id = excluded.attachment_file_id, submitted_at = now(), marked_at = null, mark = null, feedback = null, marked_by = null where public.homework_submissions.marked_at is null returning id into v_submission_id; if v_submission_id is null then raise exception 'This submission has already been marked and cannot be revised.' using errcode = '42501'; end if; return v_submission_id; end; $$; revoke all on function public.submit_homework_submission(uuid, text, uuid) from public; grant execute on function public.submit_homework_submission(uuid, text, uuid) to authenticated;
